## Notable fixes

- Selecting text in the PDF works again: the highlight shows on live-preview pages and in the dark theme.
- Typing `\includegraphics` no longer turns into `\include{graphics}`.
- Renaming a `.tex` file no longer deletes PDFs with the same name.
- Compile errors are no longer lost or pointed at the wrong file.
- Overleaf track changes are respected when you edit, and tracked deletions are shown in the right place.

## Smaller fixes

- Folder rows that stick to the top of the file tree no longer overlap the rows scrolling under them.
- Resolving or deleting a comment now confirms what happened and offers Undo.
- Comment details: a delete button, a centred reply field, a seamless popover arrow and a better-sized gutter pin.
- The caret in the agent panel is drawn at text height.
